sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.status, c.hours_to_close h, c.spread s, c.no_price p, c.review_tier rt from live_orders lo join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=lo.id where lo.strategy='Fmmsell10' and lo.status in ('filled','canceled')), tf as (select o.id, o.status, max(t.rest_seconds) rs from o join live_order_queue_ticks t on t.live_order_id=o.id group by o.id, o.status) select '1 hours_to_close '||case when h<1 then 'a under1' when h<3 then 'b 1-3' when h<6 then 'c 3-6' else 'd 6plus' end lbl, count(*)::text n, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text filled, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text pct from o group by 1 union all select '2 spread_cents '||case when s<=5 then 'a under5' when s<=20 then 'b 6-20' when s<=60 then 'c 21-60' else 'd 60plus' end, count(*)::text, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from o group by 1 union all select '3 entry_no_price '||p::text, count(*)::text, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from o group by 1 union all select '4 review_tier '||coalesce(rt,'none'), count(*)::text, count(*) filter (where status='filled')::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from o group by 1 union all select '5 rest_seconds_'||status, count(*)::text, percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by rs)::text, percentile_disc(0.9) within group (order by rs)::text from tf group by status order by 1
